# `tfctl harness context`

The `tfctl harness context` command prints coding agent context for tfctl, suitable for AGENTS.md.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness context
```

## Description

The `tfctl harness context` command prints coding agent context for tfctl. This context can be used as part of AGENTS.md or other documentation which makes coding agents more effective at using tfctl. Use the [`tfctl harness install`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/harness/install) command to install the tfctl skill for your AI coding agent, which includes this context along with agent-specific integration.

The output includes common commands with their purposes and usage patterns, conventions, and best practices for agent integration. The output instructs agents to avoid destructive operations without approval.

## Available options

The `tfctl harness context` command does not accept any command-specific options.

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

The following example demonstrates how to print coding agent context for tfctl.

### Print agent context

The following example outputs markdown-formatted text that you can include in your project's AGENTS.md file.

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness context
```
